## Grains of Rice in 1 Cup

There are approximately **9,000–10,000 grains** of rice in 1 cup of uncooked rice.

The number can vary depending on the **type of rice**:

| Rice Type | Approximate Grains per Cup |
|-----------|---------------------------|
| Long-grain white rice | ~9,000–10,000 |
| Medium-grain rice | ~8,000–9,000 |
| Short-grain rice | ~7,000–8,000 |

These are estimates, as grain size and how tightly the rice is packed can affect the count.
